subject: Dataflow & hosting evidence — SOC 2 scope and bridge letter needed before vendor review

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 evidence + hosting region confirmation

Camila,

We're kicking off EuroFin's vendor review for Redwood and need a few items to clear our InfoSec gates this week:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent year) and a bridge letter if the report doesn't cover the current audit period
- Confirmation of physical hosting region(s) for customer data (we need to know primary region, failover region, and whether UK-specific hosting is available)
- CAIQ / SIG-lite answers for data flow and encryption controls
- Any network diagram or dataflow map that shows cross-border flows and how encryption/KMS are applied

Our security signoff deadline is 2026-12-10. Can you confirm what you can provide and realistic delivery times? Also flag anything that would require contractual changes (SCCs, DPA addenda).

Thanks,

Louis Benoit
Data Protection Officer
EuroFin

Hi Louis / Camila — adding technical details here.

Summary of what we can provide immediately:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (scope: Redwood Inference hosted inference platform; control environment in scope for provisioning, change management, access controls, monitoring). Report covers period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
- Bridge letter (we will provide a signed letter confirming controls remain in place from 2026-01-01 through present; draft attached and final to be signed by our Security/Compliance lead).
- Hosting regions: primary: AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland). Secondary/failover: AWS eu-west-2 (London). We can also provide a UK-specific tenancy in eu-west-2 for customers requiring UK-only residency — this is available as a Private deployment option (requires contract amendment / provisioning lead time ~4 weeks).
- Data transfers: cross-border transfers are governed by our DPA. For controller-to-processor transfers from the UK -> Ireland, standard EU SCCs are used where applicable; for UK law equivalence we can execute the UK Addendum to the SCCs or provide a contractual SCC equivalent. Kimberly will confirm the exact wording.
- Controls: encryption at-rest using customer-specific KMS keys (if requested for Dedicated/Private); platform default is AWS-managed KMS with AES-256. KV cache and token logs are encrypted and access is role-restricted.

What we still need from you to prioritize:
- Confirm whether EuroFin requires UK-only hosting (eu-west-2) or Ireland (eu-west-1) is acceptable for the UK entity.
- Any specific SIG/CAIQ sections you want expedited (we can fast-track Identity/Access, Logging, Encryption).

Attachments provided: Hosting_Controls_Annex.xlsx (controls mapping), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (redacted), Redwood_CAiq_SIG_package_link.txt (link to hosted CAIQ export).

Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Louis Benoit <louis.benoit@eurofin.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:20:00 +0000

Thanks Markus — useful detail. A couple of quick clarifications so we can move forward:

1) For our legal/process reasons we need a statement that, for the period 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the controls relevant to data residency and encryption were in force (bridge letter should state exact audit window covered).
2) Our UK entity requires UK-only residency by default; please confirm whether the Private deployment in eu-west-2 can be provisioned under the same DPA within the 4-week window you quoted, and whether that would change your SOC scope or require an additional attestation.
3) On cross-border transfers: does Redwood rely solely on SCCs, or do you also offer a transfers impact assessment (TIA) / supplementary measures pack we can include in our file?

We have an internal vendor review on 2026-12-10; if we can get the signed bridge letter + confirmation on UK tenancy by EOD 2026-12-05 we can proceed to procurement.

Cheers,
Louis
